Rainbow-scaled, serpentine sorcerers of Limbo. Draconic, sinuous, 30 feet long, energetic crown perched atop its head.

AC 12, HP 52, ATK 2 bite +8 (3d8 + warpbite) or warp reality, MV near (fly, swim), S +3, D +2, C +3, I +3, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 11

Being of Chaos. Only damaged by silver or magical sources. Immune to acid.

Spatial Riptide. Mortal beings teleporting within far of keketar take 5d10 damage.

Warp Reality. Transform a section of terrain up to 30 feet in width and depth within double near at will, turning mud to rock, earth to air, water to wine, etc.

Warpbite. CHA 15+ or take 1d8 attribute damage. d6: 1. STR, 2. DEX, 3. CON, 4. INT, 5. WIS, 6. CHA.
